note: Does upstream vLLM's prefix caching actually save prefill on this hybrid GDN architecture? Identical 32,891-token prompt served repeatedly on vllm/vllm-openai:nightly (0.26.1rc1.dev1177) + DFlash2. hit_rate is the delta of vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total over vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total across the request. Cited in README §5.
conclusion: The first repeat never hits; the second hits at 90.2% and is 10.1x faster. A 10 s pause does not change this, so it is not a race against block release -- the prefix must be served twice before it becomes reusable.
